text: The earlier promise stands behind this scene. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and the writer turns that very promise into a test, so that everything depends upon a single word, _hineni_, "here I am," which Abraham speaks three times, to God, to Isaac, to the angel. Each time the word means something different. It costs more at every repetition, until Abraham says it for the last time to the angel.
